Ulyanovsk State Agricultural Academy
spots.summary: Ulyanovsk State Agricultural University named after P. A. Stolypin is a higher education and research institution in Ulyanovsk. It was established in 1943. The university is situated in a 1804 building by architect Andreyan Zakharov. The building is a cultural heritage monument of federal significance.
